<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pushkar Lele Lab — Blue v2</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --sans:'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
    --blue:#1657c0; --blue-deep:#0a2a6b; --blue-bright:#2e8ff5; --sky:#eaf2ff; --sky2:#d4e6ff;
    --cyan:#00c2d1; --accent:#ff8a3d;
    --line:#d7e3f4; --ink:#0f1e33; --muted:#586b84;
    --grad-hero:linear-gradient(120deg,#0a2a6b 0%,#1657c0 55%,#2e8ff5 100%);
    --grad-cta:linear-gradient(120deg,#1657c0,#2e8ff5);
    --grad-accent:linear-gradient(120deg,#2e8ff5,#00c2d1);
    --shadow-sm:0 4px 16px rgba(22,87,192,.10);
    --shadow-md:0 10px 30px rgba(22,87,192,.16);
    --shadow-lg:0 20px 50px rgba(10,42,107,.22);
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
  body{font-family:var(--sans); color:var(--ink); background:#fff; line-height:1.5;}
  em{font-style:italic;}
  .ph{color:var(--blue-bright); font-weight:600; font-style:italic;}

  .page{display:none;} .page.show{display:block;}

  /* sticky navbar */
  .nav{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:800; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:16px 48px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.96); backdrop-filter:blur(8px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .brandbox{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:13px;}
  .brandname{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:29px; color:var(--blue-deep); line-height:1; letter-spacing:-.6px;}
  .brandsub{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:600; margin-top:5px;}
  .menu{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:16px; color:#2b3a4d;} .menu span{cursor:pointer;} .menu span:hover{color:var(--blue);}
  .menu .on{color:var(--blue); border-bottom:2px solid var(--blue); padding-bottom:5px;}
  .menu .cta{background:var(--grad-cta); color:#fff; padding:12px 22px; border-radius:9px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); letter-spacing:.2px;}

  .logo-svg{width:52px; height:52px; flex-shrink:0;}

  .band{position:relative; padding:60px 48px; color:#fff; overflow:hidden; text-align:center;}
  .band-img{position:absolute; inset:0; background-size:cover; background-position:center;}
  .band-tint{position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(125deg, rgba(10,42,107,.92), rgba(22,87,192,.82) 60%, rgba(46,143,245,.7));}
  .band-c{position:relative;}
  .band .ey{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:3px; color:#7fd4ff; margin-bottom:14px; text-transform:uppercase;}
  .band h1{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:48px; line-height:1.08; letter-spacing:-1px;}
  .band p{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:18px; opacity:.95; margin-top:14px; max-width:660px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto; font-weight:500;}

  .wrap{max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto; padding:60px 40px;}
  .sec-title{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:36px; color:var(--blue-deep); text-align:center; margin-bottom:8px; letter-spacing:-.8px;}
  .sec-sub{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:16.5px; color:var(--muted); text-align:center; margin-bottom:46px;}

  .foot{background:var(--blue-deep); color:rgba(255,255,255,.75); padding:40px 48px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:28px; font-family:var(--sans); font-size:13px;}
  .foot a{color:#9fd0f5; text-decoration:none;}
  .foot .fcol h4{color:#fff; font-size:15px; margin-bottom:10px; font-weight:700;}
  .foot .fcol div{margin-bottom:5px; line-height:1.55;}

  /* ===== HOME hero (split, light, like reference) ===== */
  .hero{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; min-height:460px; background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--sky) 0%, #f5f9ff 60%, #fff 100%);}
  .hero-l{padding:70px 20px 70px 48px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center;}
  .hero-l h1{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:60px; line-height:1.05; color:var(--blue-deep); letter-spacing:-1.8px; margin-bottom:20px;}
  .hero-underline{display:none;}
  .hero-l p{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:19px; line-height:1.6; color:#3d5069; max-width:440px; margin-bottom:34px; font-weight:500;}
  .hero-l .cta{background:var(--grad-cta); color:#fff; font-weight:700; font-size:16px; padding:16px 32px; border-radius:10px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; width:fit-content; box-shadow:var(--shadow-md); letter-spacing:.2px;}
  .hero-r{position:relative; overflow:hidden;}
  .hero-r .img{position:absolute; inset:0; background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,'); background-size:cover; background-position:center;}
  .hero-r .tint{position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--sky) 0%, rgba(238,244,251,.35) 12%, rgba(238,244,251,0) 30%);}

  .rf{background:#fff; border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding:52px 48px;}
  .rf-head{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:20px; color:var(--blue-bright); margin-bottom:34px; letter-spacing:2px; text-transform:uppercase;}
  .rf-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:32px; align-items:start;}
  .rf-item{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;}
  .rf-icon{width:46px; height:46px; color:var(--blue); background:var(--sky); padding:9px; border-radius:12px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
  .rf-item h4{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:19px; color:var(--ink); letter-spacing:-.3px;}
  .rf-item p{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:15px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.6;}
  .rf-feature{background:var(--sky); border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column;}
  .rf-feature .fimg{height:110px; background-image:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1607000975931-2b1ae9c75d3a?w=600&q=80'); background-size:cover; background-position:center;}
  .rf-feature .ftext{padding:16px;}
  .rf-feature .ftext p{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:13.5px; color:#44566a; line-height:1.55; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .rf-feature .ftext a{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--blue-bright); text-decoration:none;}

  .mission{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,var(--sky)); text-align:center; padding:74px 40px;}
  .mission .ey{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:17px; letter-spacing:2.5px; color:var(--blue-bright); margin-bottom:20px; text-transform:uppercase;}
  .mission .lead{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:33px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink); max-width:860px; margin:0 auto; letter-spacing:-.7px;}
  .mission .lead b{color:var(--blue);}

  .grid4{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:18px;}
  .pill{position:relative; height:260px; border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-end; padding:24px; color:#fff; box-shadow:var(--shadow-md); transition:transform .25s, box-shadow .25s;}
  .pill-img{position:absolute; inset:0; background-size:cover; background-position:center;}
  .pill-grad{position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(10,42,107,.96) 10%, rgba(22,87,192,.25) 65%, rgba(46,143,245,.1));}
  .pill h3{position:relative; font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:21px; margin-bottom:8px; letter-spacing:-.3px;}
  .pill a{position:relative; font-family:var(--sans); color:#7fd4ff; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; text-decoration:none;}

  .recog{background:var(--grad-hero); color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-around; padding:46px 48px; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.1);}
  .stat{text-align:center;} .stat .n{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:36px; line-height:1; letter-spacing:-.5px;}
  .stat .l{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:1.2px; opacity:.9; margin-top:10px; text-transform:uppercase;}
  .rdiv{width:1px; height:44px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);}

  .lower{max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto; padding:60px 40px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr; gap:46px;}
  .news .ey{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:2px; color:var(--blue-bright); margin-bottom:22px; text-transform:uppercase;}
  .ni{padding:16px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); display:flex; gap:20px;}
  .ni .d{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:1px; color:var(--blue-bright); min-width:84px; padding-top:4px;}
  .ni .t{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:600; font-size:17.5px; line-height:1.45; color:var(--ink);}
  .join{background:var(--grad-hero); border:none; border-radius:18px; padding:36px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);}
  .join .ey{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:12.5px; letter-spacing:2px; color:#7fd4ff; margin-bottom:12px; text-transform:uppercase;}
  .join h3{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:27px; color:#fff; margin-bottom:14px; letter-spacing:-.4px;}
  .join p{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:16px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.9); line-height:1.6; margin-bottom:26px;}
  .join a{background:#fff; color:var(--blue); font-weight:700; font-size:15px; padding:14px 26px; border-radius:10px; display:inline-block; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);}

  /* RESEARCH */
  .rblock{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:40px; align-items:center; margin-bottom:52px;}
  .rblock:nth-child(even) .rtext{order:2;}
  .rimg{height:300px; border-radius:16px; background-size:cover; background-position:center; box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);}
  .rtext h3{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:29px; color:var(--blue-deep); margin-bottom:16px; letter-spacing:-.6px;}
  .rtext p{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:17px; line-height:1.7; color:#39485a;}

  /* PUBLICATIONS */
  /* MEMBERS — one group, no split */
  .pi-card{display:grid; grid-template-columns:200px 1fr; gap:32px; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(26,77,143,.06); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:14px; padding:32px; margin-bottom:44px;}
  .pi-photo{width:200px; height:230px; border-radius:10px; background-size:cover; background-position:center;}
  .pi-info h3{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:31px; color:var(--blue-deep); margin-bottom:6px; letter-spacing:-.5px;}
  .pi-info .role{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:600; font-size:15px; color:var(--blue-bright); margin-bottom:16px;}
  .pi-info p{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:15px; line-height:1.6; color:#39485a; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .pi-info .cred{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.7;}
  .role-title{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:24px; color:var(--blue-deep); margin:0 0 24px; letter-spacing:-.4px;}
  .mgrid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:24px;}
  .mcard{text-align:center;}
  .mcard .av{width:100%; aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:14px; background-size:cover; background-position:center; margin-bottom:14px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
  .mcard .nm{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:17px; color:var(--ink);}
  .mcard .rl{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px;}
  .alumni{background:#f7fafd; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px; padding:28px 32px; margin-top:40px;}
  .alumni h3{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:20px; color:var(--blue-deep); margin-bottom:16px;}
  .alumni .ag{columns:2; column-gap:40px; font-family:var(--sans); font-size:14px; line-height:1.9; color:#39485a;}

  /* FACILITIES */
  .fcard{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:32px; align-items:center; margin-bottom:40px; background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden;}
  .fcard:nth-child(even) .ftext2{order:2;}
  .fimg2{height:250px; background-size:cover; background-position:center;}
  .ftext2{padding:32px;}
  .ftext2 h3{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:22px; color:var(--blue-deep); margin-bottom:12px;}
  .ftext2 ul{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:15px; line-height:1.8; color:#39485a; padding-left:20px;}

  /* NEWS */
  .timeline{max-width:760px; margin:0 auto;}
  .tl{display:flex; gap:24px; padding-bottom:32px;}
  .tl .date{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:13px; color:var(--blue-bright); min-width:110px; text-align:right; padding-top:3px;}
  .tl .dot{position:relative; width:14px; flex-shrink:0;}
  .tl .dot::before{content:''; position:absolute; left:3px; top:6px; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--blue);}
  .tl .dot::after{content:''; position:absolute; left:6px; top:6px; bottom:-32px; width:2px; background:var(--line);}
  .tl:last-child .dot::after{display:none;}
  .tl .body h4{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:18px; color:var(--ink); margin-bottom:5px;}
  .tl .body p{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:14.5px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.55;}

  /* JOIN */
  .jhero{text-align:center; max-width:720px; margin:0 auto 44px;}
  .jhero p{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:17px; line-height:1.7; color:#39485a;}
  .jrow{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:20px; margin-bottom:44px;}
  .jc{border:1px solid var(--line); border-top:4px solid var(--blue); border-radius:12px; padding:28px;}
  .jc h3{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:19px; color:var(--blue-deep); margin-bottom:10px;}
  .jc p{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.6; color:#39485a;}
  .japply{background:var(--sky); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:14px; padding:40px; text-align:center;}
  .japply h3{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:25px; color:var(--blue-deep); margin-bottom:14px;}
  .japply p{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:15.5px; color:#39485a; line-height:1.6; max-width:580px; margin:0 auto 24px;}
  .japply a{background:var(--grad-cta); color:#fff; font-weight:700; font-size:16px; padding:16px 34px; border-radius:10px; display:inline-block; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);}
  .tsec{margin-top:60px;}
  .tgrid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:20px; margin-top:8px;}
  .tcard{background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line); border-left:4px solid var(--blue-bright); border-radius:0 12px 12px 0; padding:26px;}
  .tcard .quote{font-family:var(--sans); font-style:italic; font-size:16px; line-height:1.55; color:var(--ink); margin-bottom:16px;}
  .tcard .who{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;}
  .tcard .who .av{width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%; background-size:cover; background-position:center;}
  .tcard .who .nm{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:14px; color:var(--blue);}
  .tcard .who .pl{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted);}

  /* CONTACT */
  .cgrid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:40px;}
  .cinfo h3{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:24px; color:var(--blue-deep); margin-bottom:20px;}
  .crow{display:flex; gap:14px; margin-bottom:20px; align-items:flex-start;}
  .crow .ic{width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:8px; background:var(--sky); color:var(--blue); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:18px; flex-shrink:0;}
  .crow .ct{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:15px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink);}
  .crow .ct b{color:var(--blue);}
  .cmap{border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line); min-height:340px; background-image:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1524661135-423995f22d0b?w=900&q=80'); background-size:cover; background-position:center;}
  .formwrap{margin-top:52px; background:var(--sky); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:14px; padding:40px;}
  .formwrap h3{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:23px; color:var(--blue-deep); margin-bottom:6px;}
  .formwrap .fsub{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:14px; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:16px;}
  .formwrap .gnote{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:12px; color:var(--blue-bright); font-weight:600; margin-bottom:24px;}
  .frow{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:18px; margin-bottom:18px;}
  .fld label{display:block; font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:600; font-size:13px; color:var(--ink); margin-bottom:6px;}
  .fld input,.fld textarea{width:100%; font-family:var(--sans); font-size:14px; padding:11px 13px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px; background:#fff; color:var(--ink);}
  .fld textarea{min-height:110px; resize:vertical;}
  .fsubmit{background:var(--grad-cta); color:#fff; font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:15px; padding:15px 32px; border:none; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer; margin-top:6px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);}


  /* ===== publications: single continuous list ===== */
  .publist{max-width:900px; margin:0 auto;}
  .listhead{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; margin-bottom:28px;}
  .listhead h2{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:30px; color:var(--blue-deep); letter-spacing:-.6px; white-space:nowrap;}
  .listrule{flex:1; height:3px; background:var(--grad-accent); border-radius:2px; opacity:.55;}
  .listcount{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:12.5px; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--blue-bright); white-space:nowrap;}
  .pubitem{display:flex; gap:18px; padding:20px 22px; border-radius:12px; transition:background .18s, transform .18s; align-items:flex-start;}
  .pubitem:hover{background:var(--sky); transform:translateX(3px);}
  .pnum{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:13px; color:var(--blue-bright); background:var(--sky); border-radius:8px; min-width:32px; height:32px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0; margin-top:2px;}
  .pubitem:hover .pnum{background:#fff;}
  .ptitle{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:17px; line-height:1.45; color:var(--ink); margin-bottom:6px; letter-spacing:-.2px;}
  .pauth{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:5px;}
  .pjour{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:14.5px; color:var(--blue); font-weight:600; font-style:italic;}
  .pyear{font-style:normal; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted);}
  .pill:hover{transform:translateY(-6px); box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);}
  .mcard{transition:transform .2s;} .mcard:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);}

  /* member profile page */
  .prof-hero{background:var(--grad-hero); color:#fff; padding:56px 48px;}
  .prof-inner{max-width:1000px; margin:0 auto; display:grid; grid-template-columns:220px 1fr; gap:40px; align-items:center;}
  .prof-photo{width:220px; height:250px; border-radius:16px; background-size:cover; background-position:center; box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);}
  .prof-head .back{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:13px; color:#9fd0f5; cursor:pointer; margin-bottom:14px; display:inline-block;}
  .prof-head h1{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:40px; letter-spacing:-.8px; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .prof-head .r{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:600; font-size:17px; color:#bfe0ff; margin-bottom:16px;}
  .prof-head .links{display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .prof-head .links a{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:600; font-size:13px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.15); color:#fff; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:8px; text-decoration:none;}
  .prof-body{max-width:1000px; margin:0 auto; padding:56px 48px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr; gap:48px;}
  .prof-body h3{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:22px; color:var(--blue-deep); margin:0 0 14px; letter-spacing:-.4px;}
  .prof-body p{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:16px; line-height:1.7; color:#39485a; margin-bottom:18px;}
  .prof-side{background:var(--sky); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:14px; padding:28px; height:fit-content;}
  .prof-side h4{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:800; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:1.5px; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--blue-bright); margin-bottom:14px;}
  .prof-side .row{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:14.5px; color:var(--ink); margin-bottom:12px; line-height:1.5;}
  .prof-side .row b{display:block; color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.5px; margin-bottom:2px;}

  <div class="hero">
    <div class="hero-l">
      <h1>Understanding life at the molecular level</h1>
      <div class="hero-underline"></div>
      <p>We develop quantitative understanding of the molecular mechanisms that drive cell-signaling, cancers, and antibiotic resistance.</p>
      <a class="cta">Explore our research →</a>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-r"><div class="img"></div><div class="tint"></div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="rf">
    <div class="rf-head">Research Focus</div>
    <div class="rf-grid">
      <div class="rf-item">
        <svg class="rf-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#1a4d8f" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M9 3h6M10 3v6l-4 9a2 2 0 002 3h8a2 2 0 002-3l-4-9V3"/></svg>
        <h4>Experimental Approaches</h4>
        <p>TIRF, FRET, optical tweezers, 3D printing, micro-manipulation, and laser-darkfield imaging.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="rf-item">
        <svg class="rf-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#1a4d8f" stroke-width="1.8"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="12" rx="1"/><path d="M8 20h8M12 16v4"/></svg>
        <h4>Computational Methods</h4>
        <p>Stochastic simulations, Monte-Carlo dynamics, coarse-grained modeling, and statistical mechanics.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="rf-item">
        <svg class="rf-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#1a4d8f" stroke-width="1.8"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><circle cx="5" cy="6" r="2"/><circle cx="19" cy="6" r="2"/><circle cx="5" cy="18" r="2"/><circle cx="19" cy="18" r="2"/><path d="M7 7l3 3M17 7l-3 3M7 17l3-3M17 17l-3-3"/></svg>
        <h4>Interdisciplinary Integration</h4>
        <p>Microfluidics, molecular biology, biochemistry, and 3D printing technologies.</p>
      </div>
      </div></div>

  <div class="mission"><div class="ey">WHAT WE STUDY &amp; WHY IT MATTERS</div><div class="lead">We decode how pathogenic bacteria sense and respond to their environment — work central to fighting <b>antibiotic resistance</b>, <b>stomach cancers</b>, and <b>chronic infection</b>.</div></div>

  <div class="wrap"><div class="sec-title">Research pillars</div><div class="sec-sub">Four distinct directions, one mission.</div>

<span class="cta" onclick="go('join')">Join the Lab</span></div></div>
  <div class="band"><div class="band-img" style="background-image:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1559757148-5c350d0d3c56?w=1600&q=80')"></div><div class="band-tint"></div><div class="band-c"><div class="ey">OUR RESEARCH</div><h1>Mechanisms of infection &amp; resistance</h1><p>We deploy computational and experimental approaches to investigate how pathogens perceive and respond to environmental stresses.</p></div></div>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="rblock"><div class="rtext"><h3>Antibiotic tolerance</h3><p>We study the mechanisms by which bacteria develop tolerance against beta-lactam antibiotics, focusing on epigenetic phenomena and short-time adaptations. Working at the single-cell level, we correlate adaptive responses with alterations in the mechanical properties of the bacterial cell wall.</p></div><div class="rimg" style="background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,')"></div></div>
    <div class="rblock"><div class="rtext"><h3>Immune–pathogen interactions</h3><p>The innate immune system is our first line of defense against infection. We investigate how neutrophils exhibit diverse responses when targeting pathogenic bacteria, combining microfluidics, optical trapping, and single-molecule imaging.</p></div><div class="rimg" style="background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,')"></div></div>
    <div class="rblock"><div class="rtext"><h3>Spread of carcinogenic bacteria</h3><p><em>Helicobacter pylori</em> infections are a major cause of peptic ulcers and gastric cancers. We investigate how the chemotaxis signaling network modulates <em>H. pylori</em>'s flagellar functions to promote colonization.</p></div><div class="rimg" style="background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,')"></div></div>
    <div class="rblock"><div class="rtext"><h3>Cell mechanics &amp; mechanosensing</h3><p>Bacteria must sense attachment to a surface before establishing biofilms. We research mechanosensing in bacteria to determine how biofilms form, building on the discovery that flagellar protein components function as mechanosensors.</p></div><div class="rimg" style="background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,')"></div></div>
  </div>
